# Prepare all 6,234 individual coastal spottings with common names
coastal_points <- coastal_raw |>
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = as.Date(eventDate),
    genus = word(scientificName, 1),
    common_name = coalesce(
      unname(coastal_common_lookup[scientificName]),
      unname(genus_common_lookup[genus]),
      paste0("Coastal Marine Species (", genus, ")")
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(scientificName)) |>
  arrange(scientificName, date, id) |>
  mutate(
    first_seen = min(date),
    last_seen = max(date),
    total_span_days = as.numeric(last_seen - first_seen),
    days_elapsed = as.numeric(date - first_seen),
    spotting_num = row_number(),
    total_spottings = n(),
    .by = scientificName
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = "Coastal Spottings (New England RAS)",
    label = paste0(common_name, " (", scientificName, ")")
  )

# Prepare all 3,463 individual Arctic tern telemetry trackings with common names
arctic_points <- arctic_raw |>
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = as.Date(eventDate),
    common_name = coalesce(vernacularName, "Arctic Tern")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(organismID)) |>
  arrange(organismID, eventDate, id) |>
  mutate(
    first_seen = min(date),
    last_seen = max(date),
    total_span_days = as.numeric(last_seen - first_seen),
    days_elapsed = as.numeric(date - first_seen),
    spotting_num = row_number(),
    total_spottings = n(),
    .by = c(scientificName, organismID)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = "Arctic Trackings (Arctic Tern Telemetry)",
    label = paste0(common_name, " — ", organismID, " (", scientificName, ")")
  )

all_occurrences <- bind_rows(
  coastal_points |>
    select(
      id, common_name, scientificName, label, group, date, first_seen, last_seen,
      days_elapsed, total_span_days, spotting_num, total_spottings,
      decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude
    ),
  arctic_points |>
    select(
      id, common_name, scientificName, label, group, date, first_seen, last_seen,
      days_elapsed, total_span_days, spotting_num, total_spottings,
      decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>Common Name: ", common_name, "</b><br>",
      "Scientific Name: <i>", scientificName, "</i><br>",
      "Organism / ID: ", label, "<br>",
      "Group: ", group, "<br>",
      "Event Date: ", date, "<br>",
      "Spotting / Tracking #: ", spotting_num, " of ", total_spottings, "<br>",
      "Days Elapsed: ", days_elapsed, " days (Total Span: ", total_span_days, " days)<br>",
      "Coordinates: (", round(decimalLatitude, 3), ", ", round(decimalLongitude, 3), ")"
    )
  )

shared_occurrences <- SharedData$new(all_occurrences)

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = shared_occurrences,
  x = ~days_elapsed,
  y = ~spotting_num,
  color = ~group,
  colors = c(
    "Arctic Trackings (Arctic Tern Telemetry)" = "#0072B2",
    "Coastal Spottings (New England RAS)" = "#D55E00"
  ),
  text = ~hover_text,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "scattergl",
  mode = "markers",
  width = "100%",
  height = 680,
  marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.65)
) |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    margin = list(t = 125, r = 25, b = 65, l = 65),
    title = list(
      text = "Individual Spottings & Trackings Over Observation Date Span",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = 0.97,
      yanchor = "top"
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Observation Date Span Elapsed (Days Since First Sighting)",
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE, thickness = 0.08)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Cumulative Spotting / Tracking Count"
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 1.03, yanchor = "bottom"),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        x = 0,
        xanchor = "left",
        y = 1.03,
        yanchor = "bottom",
        buttons = list(
          list(
            label = "View: All Timeframes (0–3,652 Days)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.autorange" = TRUE,
              "yaxis.autorange" = TRUE
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "View: Spread Evenly (Log Scale X-Axis)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "log",
              "xaxis.autorange" = TRUE,
              "yaxis.autorange" = TRUE
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: 0–300 Days (Arctic vs. Coastal Overlap)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(-5, 305),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 500)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: Coastal Detail (0–300 Days, 1–50 Spottings)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(-5, 305),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 55)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: 1–5 Years (365–1,825 Days)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(365, 1825),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 140)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: 5–10 Years (1,825–3,700 Days)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(1825, 3700),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 140)
            ))
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>
  config(responsive = TRUE)
```
